title: cross_well_dg: Cross-well lithofacies evaluation protocols under domain shift (FORCE 2020)
description: CPU-reproducible, leakage-restricted evaluation protocols and baselines for cross-well lithofacies classification on the FORCE 2020 well-log corpus. Includes Python pipeline (data preparation, Protocol-1/2/3, Hybrid / CORAL models), configs, well-split definitions, experiment CSV/JSON summaries, figure scripts and release manifests. Manuscript LaTeX/PDF are journal-only and are not redistributed here. Raw FORCE LAS files are not redistributed; cite the FORCE Zenodo release (10.5281/zenodo.4351156).
